purpose: Source-linked inventory for realistic mobile, browser, computer-use, terminal, and stateful tool evaluation of a sub-100M WebGPU agent.
policy: Public links are references, not permission to copy benchmark prompts. Training rows require a reviewed license, an official train split, a content hash, and a source-specific adapter. Runtime benchmarks remain evaluation-only.

entries.name: AndroidControl
entries.webgpu_projection: Goal plus compact accessibility tree; screenshot and raw coordinates require a visual/coordinate bridge.
entries.primary_metric: Exact normalized action and episode/trajectory success on official app/task splits.
entries.split_rule: Train only on the official training partition; hold out app/task generalization splits.
entries.notes: Existing bounded normalization and replay receipts cover 26 train-side records; no emulator reward is claimed.

entries.name: Android in the Wild (AITW)
entries.webgpu_projection: Instruction plus text accessibility projection; pixels are retained only for a future visual encoder.
entries.primary_metric: Action/trajectory exactness under official task-app-platform splits.
entries.split_rule: Keep unseen instruction, app, and platform partitions out of training.
entries.notes: The source is large and visual; ingestion must bind archive bytes and attribution before normalization.

entries.name: AndroidWorld
entries.webgpu_projection: Accessibility tree plus goal for a text-first baseline; pixels require a vision encoder.
entries.primary_metric: Environment reward and task completion over resettable emulator episodes.
entries.split_rule: Task templates and generated goals are evaluator-only; report task/seed identities and emulator manifest.
entries.notes: 116 hand-authored tasks across 20 apps with dynamic parameterization; the current machine has no Android emulator.

entries.name: MobileGym / MobileGym-Bench
entries.webgpu_projection: Structured JSON state plus goal; compact enough for text-first control and deterministic local reward.
entries.primary_metric: AnswerSheet task success, dense state reward, and sim-to-real retention.
entries.split_rule: Use the 160 train and 256 test templates only after pinning the release; never train on test templates.
entries.notes: Pinned release has 28 simulated apps, 416 templates, and a disjoint 160-template train/256-task test contract. The current checkpoint completed the full official test split at 1/256 (0.39%) using text/DOM state only; screenshots and visual grounding were not used. Benchmark data remains CC-BY-NC-4.0 and evaluation-only.

entries.name: MobileSafetyBench
entries.webgpu_projection: Refusal, confirmation, side-effect, and indirect-prompt-injection probes over compact synthetic state; no native safety claim.
entries.primary_metric: Safety score, helpfulness score, harmful-action rate, and injection-defense rate.
entries.split_rule: Safety prompts, emulator snapshots, APKs, and attack variants remain evaluation-only; report the pinned Android/Appium/ADB environment.
entries.notes: The pinned source/paper contract reports 100 tasks: 50 helpfulness, 42 safety-scored, and 8 indirect prompt-injection tasks across six operational areas. The current project page reports a separate 250-task scope (200 daily plus 50 injection); select and hash one release before scoring rather than combining counts.

entries.name: iOSWorld
entries.webgpu_projection: Compact state, identity, and MCP-schema rehearsal; visual phone control requires an image encoder and iOS Simulator.
entries.primary_metric: Strict task pass and rubric score by single-app, multi-app, and memory/personalization categories.
entries.split_rule: Seeded identity, apps, task files, and rubrics remain evaluation-only until the release and simulator image are frozen.
entries.notes: The pinned source/paper contract reports 26 apps and 133 tasks: 27 single-app, 60 multi-app, and 46 memory/personalization tasks.

entries.name: MobileWorld
entries.webgpu_projection: Accessibility/state text plus explicit tool calls; no visual score without an image encoder.
entries.primary_metric: Long-horizon task success across agent-user and MCP-augmented workflows.
entries.split_rule: Keep the public evaluation tasks and generated parameters out of SFT/RL until a release split is pinned.
entries.notes: m302 pins and inventories all 201 task classes across 20 applications. The source/runtime audit executed no emulator, user simulator, MCP service, or task; Docker/KVM host prerequisites and benchmark asset terms remain unresolved.

entries.name: MobileAgentBench
entries.webgpu_projection: Goal plus accessibility/text projection; visual action grounding is a separate modality ablation.
entries.primary_metric: Task completion over 100 tasks and 10 open-source apps.
entries.split_rule: Do not use benchmark task instructions or app states as training data without an explicit release split.
entries.notes: Efficient device benchmark suitable for a small smoke suite once the official materials and app images are pinned.

entries.name: Mobile-Bench
entries.webgpu_projection: Structured UI/API text for a protocol probe; real-device state is required for task success.
entries.primary_metric: Mobile task completion and API/UI action accuracy.
entries.split_rule: Evaluation devices, app data, and task prompts remain outside training.
entries.notes: The official repository documents both API and UI evaluation modes and requires a prepared device state.

entries.name: BrowserGym / MiniWoB++
entries.webgpu_projection: Goal plus compact DOM/accessibility tree with explicit element grounding.
entries.primary_metric: Closed-loop episode reward, success, action error, and timeout rate.
entries.split_rule: Pin task metadata, seeds, browser executable, Playwright, viewport, locale, and max steps.
entries.notes: The repository includes MiniWoB, WebArena, VisualWebArena, WorkArena, AssistantBench, and WebLINX integrations; current native MiniWoB receipts are 0/240 and 5/240 after adapter training.

entries.name: Mind2Web
entries.webgpu_projection: Cleaned DOM plus task; candidate ranking supplies a safe text-first grounding bridge.
entries.primary_metric: Element accuracy, operation F1, step success, and task success.
entries.split_rule: Train only on official train files; cross-task, cross-website, and cross-domain archives stay protected/evaluation-only.
entries.notes: Bounded public-train continuations improve teacher-forced metrics but have not established an official test score.

entries.name: WebLINX
entries.webgpu_projection: Text/action-history projection only; native element IoU requires the pinned evaluator.
entries.primary_metric: Intent match, element IoU, text F1, and micro action metrics.
entries.split_rule: Use compact train only after privacy filtering; test_web remains held out and requires residual legal review.
entries.notes: Noncommercial/share-alike terms and sensitive-content filtering make public trained-weight redistribution a separate legal decision.

entries.name: WebArena / VisualWebArena
entries.webgpu_projection: DOM text can test navigation; visual and multi-site claims require the live benchmark deployment.
entries.primary_metric: End-to-end task success and per-site state verification.
entries.split_rule: Never train on evaluation goals, seeded site state, or verifier traces.
entries.notes: Credentialed or mutable sites make a clean local BrowserGym/MiniWoB baseline preferable for first WebGPU publication.

entries.name: AgentNet / OpenCUA
entries.webgpu_projection: Text-only action vocabulary is a diagnostic; screenshots require a vision/coordinate encoder.
entries.primary_metric: Offline action/trajectory accuracy and native AgentNetBench/OSWorld task success.
entries.split_rule: Train only on train parents; validation/test parents and task/platform identities remain held out.
entries.notes: Bounded text continuation shows initialization gains but is not AgentNetBench or native desktop evidence.

entries.name: Computer Agent Arena
entries.webgpu_projection: Instruction/action-family diagnostic only; no visual grounding or human-evaluation claim.
entries.primary_metric: Human correctness plus action and trajectory diagnostics.
entries.split_rule: Deduplicate task/model identities and keep evaluation battles out of training.
entries.notes: The source has 4,641 trajectories and 99,765 steps; image archives are intentionally withheld locally.

entries.name: OSWorld
entries.webgpu_projection: Text/action protocol audit only; a VM and screenshot grounding are required for score.
entries.primary_metric: Execution-based task success on real desktop environments.
entries.split_rule: Task cards, VM images, and evaluation goals are runtime-only and version-bound.
entries.notes: No desktop VM is attached to the current worktree.

entries.name: OSWorld 2.0
entries.webgpu_projection: Text-only protocol replay; native score requires the matching VM, task files, assets, and mocked sites.
entries.primary_metric: Long-horizon execution success and task completion.
entries.split_rule: Use code, task files, assets, and mocked websites from one release; never mix main/latest.
entries.notes: The official release notes explicitly identify gated task files/assets and a release-aware setup.

entries.name: Apple ToolSandbox
entries.webgpu_projection: State-dependency, canonicalization, and insufficient-information probes over a local contract.
entries.primary_metric: Intermediate and final milestone success over arbitrary stateful trajectories.
entries.split_rule: Scenario prompts, user simulation, tools, and verifiers remain evaluation-only.
entries.notes: The pinned AST profile reports 129 base scenarios and 1,032 source-level variants; no simulator was executed locally.

entries.name: MCPMark
entries.webgpu_projection: Tool routing, schema validity, abstention, and local state-machine rehearsal.
entries.primary_metric: Pass@k, pass^k, and verifier success across Notion, GitHub, filesystem, Postgres, and Playwright.
entries.split_rule: Task text, credentials, service state, and verifiers stay out of SFT; use isolated official runners.
entries.notes: Pinned metadata includes 239 rows; the local +13.81 point selector result is a service-contract proxy, not MCPMark success.

entries.name: EnterpriseOps-Gym
entries.webgpu_projection: Name/schema retrieval and local state transitions; server execution is required for task success.
entries.primary_metric: Final-state SQL verifier success and long-horizon tool use.
entries.split_rule: Keep task descriptions, server configuration, and verifiers evaluation-only.
entries.notes: The public card reconciles 512 tools, eight domains, 649 oracle rows, and 637 rows per distractor mode; local work has no server run.

entries.name: xLAM Function Calling 60K
entries.webgpu_projection: Compact tool schemas plus canonical JSON calls; no external side effects.
entries.primary_metric: Held-out tool, argument, and JSON validity accuracy under an AST checker.
entries.split_rule: Use only the official train partition for SFT; exclude BFCL and evaluation prompts by exact denylist.
entries.notes: Public 60K function-calling corpus used as a schema/argument training source; acquisition must record dataset revision and row hashes before use.

entries.name: Team-ACE/ToolACE
entries.webgpu_projection: Strict first-action, full multi-turn, and action-history Conversation projections; action-history retains user/tool state and strict assistant calls while omitting non-action assistant prose.
entries.primary_metric: Held-out teacher-forced and free-run tool/argument/sequence diagnostics plus history-turn and prose-omission audits; official ToolACE/BFCL scores remain external.
entries.split_rule: Use only the pinned source bytes; the current split is source-record and normalized-prompt disjoint and is not an upstream official split.
entries.notes: m171 first-action accepted 8,993/11,300; m172 full history and m173 action-history accepted 8,992/11,300, with m173 retaining 1,357 tool responses and omitting 1,806 assistant prose turns. m176 catalog-aware selector and m177 dynamic-pointer probes are measured with matched random controls but are not adopted when warm transfer loses the control or fails to improve free-run exactness.

entries.name: AppWorld
entries.webgpu_projection: Compact API schemas and state summaries; rich interactive code generation is outside the current action head.
entries.primary_metric: Execution/unit-test success with collateral-damage checks.
entries.split_rule: Benchmark tasks and app state are evaluator-only; do not train on task code or tests.
entries.notes: The official site describes nine apps, 457 APIs, 106 simulated people, and 750 benchmark tasks.

entries.name: AppWorld-UL
entries.webgpu_projection: Clarification, confirmation, infeasible-request, and safe-abstention decisions over compact app state; full AppWorld execution and user simulation remain runtime-only.
entries.primary_metric: Task/scenario success with user-interaction correctness and compositional-task breakdown.
entries.split_rule: Keep the 516 task prompts, user-simulator policies, app state, and verifiers evaluation-only; pin the AppWorld release before scoring.
entries.notes: The official UL page links the Apache-2.0 AppWorld runner, which documents resettable execution and evaluation. The UL-specific task assets and user-simulator release are not separately pinned here, so native UL scoring remains blocked.

entries.name: τ-Bench
entries.webgpu_projection: Text-only multi-turn tool use with explicit user correction and policy checks.
entries.primary_metric: Task reward, policy adherence, and tool-agent-user interaction success.
entries.split_rule: Domain policies, task prompts, and user simulator traces remain evaluation-only.
entries.notes: Pinned tau2-bench v1.0.1 source and resettable mock domain are exercised by m252 for an oracle verifier contract plus a one-turn LocalAgent probe; the complete base split, user simulator, retail/telecom runs, and leaderboard protocol remain unexecuted.

entries.name: TUA-Bench
entries.webgpu_projection: Command/tool schema projection; terminal execution and safety policy remain runtime-only.
entries.primary_metric: Execution-based task success over deterministic terminal setups.
entries.split_rule: Task setup scripts and evaluator fixtures are not SFT inputs.
entries.notes: Useful for a computer-use coverage gap: GUI-only suites do not measure general terminal control.

entries.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard
entries.webgpu_projection: Stateless schema-constrained tool calls and abstention; no stateful environment claim.
entries.primary_metric: Official AST checker accuracy across single, multiple, parallel, and irrelevance categories.
entries.split_rule: Prompt-only denylist for corpus exclusion; official gold/checker remains evaluation-only.
entries.notes: BFCL is a function-calling control, not a browser/mobile benchmark; it isolates schema/argument competence.

entries.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard V4 agentic categories
entries.webgpu_projection: Stateful tool-schema, abstention, and format-sensitivity diagnostics; live search, memory stores, and external APIs require the official runtime.
entries.primary_metric: Official BFCL V4 AST/execution metrics for multi-turn, agentic web-search, memory-management, and format-sensitivity categories.
entries.split_rule: Freeze the upstream BFCL release and official checker; never train on evaluation prompts, live-service traces, or gold responses.
entries.notes: This row separates the current V4 agentic categories from the pinned stateless prompt-only BFCL rows already used for decontamination.
